_comment: Opening hours per early-voting site, used for the 'ballots per hour open'
view in the site grid. Empty until real schedule data is added — the UI
shows that view as unavailable rather than inventing an hours figure.
Resolution order for a given (site, date), first match wins:
<dow> is one of sun mon tue wed thu fri sat. Values are hours open as a
number (7.5 is fine). A site with no match on a date it recorded ballots
is reported by the build rather than silently skipped.
